bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to judiciary; increasing penalties for antitrust violations; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 325D.56.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 325D.56, is amended to read:

325D.56 PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION.

Subdivision 1.
Civil penalties.
Any person who is found to have violated sections 325D.49 to 325D.66, shall be subject to a civil penalty of not more than [-$50,000-][+ $150,000+]. Any person who fails to comply with a final judgment or decree rendered by a court of this state issued for a violation of sections 325D.49 to 325D.66, shall be subject to a civil penalty of not more than [-$100,000-][+ $300,000+].

Subd. 2.
Criminal penalty.
Any person who is found to have willfully committed any of the acts enumerated in section 325D.53 shall be guilty of a felony and subject to a fine of not more than [-$50,000-][+ $150,000+] or imprisonment in the state penitentiary for not more than seven years, or both.
